test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is correctly matched with their leadership role in the Constituent Assembly (During the making of the Indian constitution)?

options.text: G.V. Mavalankar - Chairman of the Committee on the Functions of the Constituent Assembly
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar - Head of the Committee on the Functions of the Assembly
N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar - Chairman of the Order of Business Committee
K.M. Munshi-Leader of the Committee on Fundamental Rights

solution:
The correct answer is __**G.V. Mavalankar - Chairman of the Committee on the Functions of the Constituent Assembly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **G.V. Mavalankar**, a prominent figure in the Constituent Assembly, served as the Chairman of the Committee on the Functions of the Constituent Assembly.
 
• The Committee was responsible for laying down the procedural framework for the Constituent Assembly.
 
• Mavalankar also played a significant role as the first Speaker of the Lok Sabha post-independence, showcasing his leadership capabilities.
 
• His contributions were instrumental in ensuring a smooth and structured functioning of the Assembly during the drafting of the Constitution of India.
 
• The Committee on the Functions of the Constituent Assembly focused on defining the scope and operational procedures of the Assembly, ensuring clarity in its roles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar:**

 
 
• He was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly.
 
• Ambedkar is widely regarded as the architect of the Indian Constitution due to his pivotal role in drafting it.
 
 
 
• **Constituent Assembly:**
 
 
• The Constituent Assembly was formed in 1946 to draft the Constitution of India.
 
• It consisted of representatives from various regions and communities to ensure inclusivity.
 
• The Assembly held extensive debates and discussions before finalizing the Constitution in November 1949.
